scope: dedicated draft-runtime journal only; not the Commerce application database

commerce_runtime_tasks.policy: Request fingerprint and source IDs, no separately stored request source bodies; generated result may quote source text. Result hidden at earliest original source expiry and redacted 7 days later by privileged bounded purge. Task/request skeleton remains to prevent repeat execution. No automatic schedule/export/restore.

commerce_runtime_tokens.policy: Single-use token jti, tenant and expiry only. Token bytes and signing keys not stored. Privileged bounded purge may remove rows 1 day after expiry; signature/expiry checks still precede every call.
